title: Build Your Team
subtitle: Build people who build the company leadership is the product.
description: The best product in the world fails with the wrong team. The best team in the world fails without clear direction, honest feedback, and the right structure. This module gives you the complete leadership toolkit from clarifying who owns what, to setting goals that drive real action, to having the honest conversations that most leaders avoid. It includes three Japanese leadership frameworks that bring a depth of discipline most Western management books miss.

roleProfile.question: Who should advise on people and leadership decisions?
roleProfile.lead: Leadership decisions are the highest-leverage decisions in any organisation — and the hardest to get right because the stakes are human. The roles on this page bring the perspectives of people who have seen hundreds of teams succeed and fail. Use them before hiring, before giving difficult feedback, before restructuring, and before having the conversations you have been avoiding.
